mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for shower installation in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in Daly City, as well as other cities we serve like South San Francisco and San Bruno, plumbing work and structural changes associated with shower installation typically require permits. This ensures the work complies with local building codes and safety standards. City Dweller, LLC handles all necessary permit applications and inspections for your project, ensuring compliance and peace of mind.
